Every figure above was re-derived from its ingredients by a checker of 20 assertions, and then each ingredient was corrupted deliberately to confirm the checker can see it. BOTH_DIRECTIONS_AND_THE_GAP_THAT_FOUND.presence: M3 confirms a missing object is visible -- the checker counts arrivals (240, 36, 279), it does not only ask whether the objects it sees reconcile.
BOTH_DIRECTIONS_AND_THE_GAP_THAT_FOUND.absence: M2 confirms 'dedup frees 0 B' is falsifiable rather than vacuous. A zero that cannot be made non-zero is not a measurement.
BOTH_DIRECTIONS_AND_THE_GAP_THAT_FOUND.WHY_M4_AND_M5_EXIST: M1-M3 all left the attribution checks green, because those rest on timestamps and not on bytes. So the load-bearing conclusion of this whole receipt was, at that point, asserted by checks that nothing had ever made fail. M4 and M5 were added for exactly that reason and break it in both available directions -- the notice outside the copy window, and p3f not dominant. This is BEN-117's lesson applied to a derivation instead of a gate: a check that cannot be made to fail has not been tested, and the checks most likely to go untested are the ones carrying the conclusion.
